command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLBACKEND=Agg
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OBSPY_THREADS=16 OBSPY_DIR=/tmp/day187
cd /tmp
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
T0=$(date +%s)
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 > pins.check 2>&1 || { grep -v ': OK$' pins.check; echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
NOK=$(grep -c ': OK$' pins.check)
echo "pinned_files_verified $NOK in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
test "$NOK" -eq 962 || { echo "FAIL: verified $NOK pinned files, expected 962"; exit 1; }
V=$(python3 -c "import obspy; print(obspy.__version__)" 2>&1)
echo "obspy_running $V"
test "$V" = "1.5.1" || { echo "FAIL: obspy $V, expected 1.5.1"; exit 1; }
{ lscpu | grep -iE 'model name|^cpu\(s\)|thread\(s\) per core|numa node\(s\)'; python3 -u corename.py; uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'; df -h /tmp; } > cpu.txt 2>&1
cat cpu.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u real.py > real.log 2>&1
RC=$?
echo "real.py exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
cat real.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: the workload failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'OBSPY REAL OK' real.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
